title: Wegleitung Natürliche Personen 2025
why_needed: Official guide for completing the natural persons return for tax year 2025
notes: Publication date not stated in the PDF. Standard deadline 15 March, 15 May for self-employed, farmers and certain partnerships. Written for paper forms; names TaxMe-Online for online filing.

title: Guide Personnes physiques 2025
publisher: Intendance des impôts du canton de Berne
why_needed: French version of the 2025 natural persons guide (preferred language)
notes: Title as read from the fetched text; check the cover page. States a 30-day objection (reclamation) period from notification that cannot be extended. Publication date not stated.

title: Wegleitung Natürliche Personen 2024 / 2025 (Änderungen)
why_needed: Lists what changed for tax year 2025 compared with 2024
notes: Comparison document; the exact title as printed was not confirmed.

title: Steuererklärung 2025 Natürliche Personen
why_needed: Printable form set for the 2025 natural persons return and annexes
notes: Form codes DT0001 to DT0006 and DT0008 present (DT0006 is professional costs 2025). Forms 7, 9 and 10 (real estate, self-employment, agriculture) are referenced but not included in this PDF.

title: Aktuelles aus Ihrer Steuerverwaltung: Wichtig zu wissen für Ihre Steuererklärung 2025
why_needed: Current official summary of filing channels, extension fees, 2025 deductions and 2026 prepayment changes
notes: Published January 2026 (day not stated). Extension fee schedule was read from a summary of this sheet; confirm against the PDF before relying on it. Mentions the AGOV login for natural persons.

title: Steuererklärung online einreichen via Dr. Tax (Sicht Treuhänder)
why_needed: Official steps and release options for electronic filing through Dr. Tax
notes: Version 4/2025. Describes the taxpayer release via BE-Login or a signed release receipt. No list of approved software in this guide. A French version is described as existing but was not verified.

title: Dr. Tax Steuererklärungen: Häufige Fragen, Sicht Treuhänder/Treuhänderin
why_needed: States that only the taxpayer may release a return via BE-Login
notes: Page headers dated 2020 (08.09.2020 and 19.08.2020), older than the 4/2025 guide. Use for the release rule and absence of an approval list only.

title: Steuergesetz (StG) vom 21.05.2000 (Stand 01.01.2025), BSG 661.11
why_needed: Legal basis for the cantonal income tariff, cantonal rate and professional cost deductions
notes: Consolidated version Stand 01.01.2025. The fetched text reached only Art. 54, so source tax and procedure articles were not checked. A later Stand may exist.

title: Steueranlagen der Gemeinden und Steuersätze der Kirchgemeinden für 2025 (Dokument 556.6)
why_needed: Municipal quotas (quotités) for 2025 for each commune, plus the cantonal rate section
notes: French version Quotités d'impôt des communes et taux d'impôt des paroisses pour 2025 under the same document number (not separately verified). Publication date not stated.

title: Steueranlagen der Gemeinden und Steuersätze der Kirchgemeinden für 2026 (Dokument 556.6)
why_needed: Municipal quotas for 2026 for each commune
notes: Marked Stand 01.02.2026, used as the published date. French version under the same document number (not separately verified).

title: Steuertabellen für die Quellensteuer, Edition 2026 / Barèmes fiscaux concernant l'impôt à la source
why_needed: 2026 source tax tables for withholding on wages
notes: One PDF in German and French. Covers tariff groups A and H, B, C and G, with and without church tax. No validity start date stated.

title: Nachträgliche ordentliche Veranlagung (NOV), Aktuelles aus Ihrer Steuerverwaltung 2025
why_needed: Rules on who may request NOV from source tax, the deadline, irrevocability and submission
notes: Request due by 31 March of the following year. Deadline ends at deregistration when leaving Switzerland. No rectification deadline stated. No version number or publication date printed.

title: Antrag nachträgliche ordentliche Veranlagung (NOV) für Ansässige
why_needed: Request form for NOV by Swiss residents
notes: Form version 7.2025. Tax year field is blank, and a blank year means the previous year. Irrevocable once filed on time. Due 31 March of the following year. Send by email to nov.sv@be.ch or by post to Steuerverwaltung des Kantons Bern, Quellensteuer / NOV, Postfach, 3001 Bern.

title: Einkommenssteuer (Art. 42 Abs. 1 - Verheiratete), ab Steuerjahr 2025
why_needed: Income tax table for married couples and single-parent families (unit rate and einfache Steuer per taxable income) for tax year 2025.
notes: 62 pages, heading ab Steuerjahr: 2025. The TaxInfo link redirects to a PDF named Tarif Art. 42 - Abs. 1 - 2025-20XX_d.pdf; the 2026 table replaces it. PDF metadata title is a template leftover (Kapitalleistungen aus Vorsorge); trust the printed heading. Linked from TaxInfo page Tarif Einkommenssteuer.

title: Einkommenssteuer (Art. 42 Abs. 2 - Alleinstehende), ab Steuerjahr 2025
why_needed: Income tax table for all other taxpayers (single tariff) for tax year 2025.
notes: 62 pages, heading ab Steuerjahr: 2025. Redirects to Tarif Art. 42 - Abs. 2 - 2025-20XX_d.pdf. Same metadata quirk as the married table.

title: Einkommenssteuer (Art. 42 Abs. 1 - Verheiratete), ab Steuerjahr 2026
why_needed: Income tax table for married couples and single-parent families for tax year 2026, after the cold progression adjustment.
notes: 62 pages, heading ab Steuerjahr: 2026. Redirects to Tarif Art. 42 - Abs. 1 - 2026-20XX_d.pdf. TaxInfo says there is no cold progression adjustment for 2027.

title: Einkommenssteuer (Art. 42 Abs. 2 - Alleinstehende), ab Steuerjahr 2026
why_needed: Income tax table for all other taxpayers (single tariff) for tax year 2026.
notes: 62 pages, heading ab Steuerjahr: 2026. Redirects to Tarif Art. 42 - Abs. 2 - 2026-20XX_d.pdf.

title: Tarif Einkommenssteuer
why_needed: Which of the two Art. 42 tariffs applies (married and single-parent families versus others, cohabiting parents, year-end rule, divorce, death) and links to the yearly tables.
notes: Server-rendered TaxInfo page, Fassung vom 17 Oct 2025. Linked from sv.fin.be.ch Steuern berechnen, Privatperson. Lists tables for 2024, 2025 and ab 2026.

title: Steuergesetz (StG) vom 21.05.2000 (Stand 01.01.2026), BSG 661.11
why_needed: Law text for tax year 2026: income tariff Art. 42, wealth tariff Art. 65, deductions Art. 31 to 40, source tax and procedure.
notes: 204 pages, Stand 01.01.2026. belex lists it as the current version in force since 01.01.2026 (decision 26.03.2025, which also carries the 2026 cold progression adjustment). Version 3018 (be-2025-stg-de) was in force 01.01.2025 to 31.12.2025.

title: Abzüge und Freigrenzen nach Steuerjahr (Abzüge 2022-2026)
why_needed: One table of every cantonal and federal deduction amount and cap by tax year, including 2025 and 2026 (children, commuting, insurance, childcare, dual earner, training, party donations, wealth tax deductions).
notes: Columns BE/Gemeinde and Bund for 2022 to 2026; changes against the prior year are highlighted. Linked from the TaxInfo page Ausgleich der kalten Progression (Fassung vom 14 Jul 2026, date used as published). The file name carries the year range, so the URL will likely change when 2027 is added; re-find it from that page.

title: Ausgleich der kalten Progression
why_needed: Stable page for the cantonal and federal indexation per year and the link to the current deductions table.
notes: Fassung vom 14 Jul 2026. Links pages for adjustments per 2024, 2025 and 2026 and says there is no adjustment per 2027. The 2026 adjustment came with the StG change of 26.03.2025.

title: Verordnung über die Berufskosten (Berufskostenverordnung, BKV) vom 18.10.2000 (Stand 01.01.2024), BSG 661.312.56
why_needed: Which employee professional costs are deductible and the partial flat rates: commuting, extra meal costs, other professional costs, weekly stay away from home and side income.
notes: 7 pages, Stand 01.01.2024. belex lists this as the current version (in force since 01.01.2024, no future version), so it covers 2025 and 2026. The TaxInfo Berufskosten page still links the old belex frontend version 909.

title: Fahrkosten für den Arbeitsweg
why_needed: Commuting cost rules for bicycle and small motorbikes, public transport, employer-paid passes and private cars, and the cap.
notes: Fassung vom 23 Dec 2025. Amounts shown are for tax year 2025; other years are in the deductions table be-na-deductions-abzuege-freigrenzen. Cites a 2025 federal court decision on the time-saving test.

title: Versicherungsabzug
why_needed: Insurance premium and savings interest deduction rules for married and single taxpayers, with and without pension contributions, plus the amount per child.
notes: Fassung vom 29 Dec 2025. Tables are for tax year 2025; other years in the deductions table.

title: Kinderdrittbetreuungskosten
why_needed: Conditions for deducting third-party childcare costs (age limit, causal link to work or training, what counts) cantonally and federally.
notes: Fassung vom 10 Jul 2025. Caps per year are in the deductions table.

title: Zweiverdienerabzug
why_needed: How the dual-earner deduction for married couples is computed cantonally and federally.
notes: Fassung vom 3 Dec 2025. Amounts shown are for tax year 2025; other years in the deductions table.

title: Beiträge an die Säule 3a (gebundene Vorsorge)
why_needed: Pillar 3a deduction rules, the yearly maxima for 2025 and 2026, and the new 3a buy-in (Nachzahlung) possible from tax year 2026.
notes: Fassung vom 5 Jun 2026. Refers to ESTV circular 18a of 22 December 2025. Says buy-ins for gaps from 2025 are first possible in tax year 2026.

title: Homeoffice bei unselbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit
why_needed: Bern practice on home-office costs (workroom, IT equipment) for employees; there is no separate home-office deduction.
notes: Fassung vom 09.12.2020. On days a workroom is claimed, commuting and meal deductions are not allowed.

title: Berufsorientierte Aus- und Weiterbildung
why_needed: Rules and cap for job-related training costs, also relevant for source-taxed people.
notes: Fassung vom 30 Dec 2025. Amount shown is for tax year 2025; other years in the deductions table.

title: Krankheits- und Unfallkosten
why_needed: Which medical and accident costs are deductible, the proof needed and the 5 percent of net income threshold.
notes: Fassung vom 1 Sept 2026. Points to ESTV circular 11a/2026 from tax year 2027.

title: Steuertabellen für die Quellensteuer, Ausgabe 2025 / Barèmes fiscaux concernant l'impôt à la source, Edition 2025
why_needed: 2025 source tax tables for withholding on wages.
notes: 58 pages, German and French. Tariffs A and H, B, C, each with and without church tax, plus G. Linked as Druckversion from sv.fin.be.ch Steuern berechnen, Quellensteuer.

title: Steuertabellen Quellensteuer 2025
why_needed: Machine-readable 2025 source tax tables.
notes: Sheets Deckblatt, Tarif A + H mit/ohne Kirche, Tarif B mit/ohne Kirche, Tarif C mit/ohne Kirche, Tarif G; each sheet headed with the year 2025.

title: Steuertabellen Quellensteuer 2026
why_needed: Machine-readable 2026 source tax tables.
notes: Same sheet layout as 2025, each sheet headed with the year 2026.

title: Grundlagen für die Berechnung der Quellensteuertarife des Kantons Bern, Steuerjahr 2026
why_needed: Deductions built into each source tax tariff code, with StG article references, needed to compare withholding with an ordinary assessment.
notes: Sheets Deutsch and Französisch. The file name has no year, so the same URL will carry the 2027 basis later; no 2025 edition was found.

title: Antrag nachträgliche ordentliche Veranlagung (NOV) für Nichtansässige
why_needed: NOV request form for people living abroad who are taxed at source in Bern (quasi-residents).
notes: Form version 7.2026, 3 pages. Due 31 March of the following year; a blank tax year means the previous year; irrevocable once filed on time; requires at least 90 percent of worldwide income (spouse included) taxable in Switzerland. Email nov.sv@be.ch or post to Quellensteuer / NOV, Postfach, 3001 Bern.

title: Quellensteuerverordnung (QSV) vom 16.09.2020 (Stand 01.01.2021), BSG 661.711.1
why_needed: Cantonal source tax ordinance: tariff calculation, NOV conditions and procedure.
notes: 14 pages, Stand 01.01.2021. belex lists it as the current version (in force since 01.01.2021, no future version).

title: Nachträgliche ordentliche Veranlagung auf Antrag
why_needed: Practice on NOV requests by Swiss residents: 31 March deadline, deregistration, defective requests, what happens after.
notes: Fassung vom 29.01.2021.

title: Obligatorische nachträgliche ordentliche Veranlagung
why_needed: When a source-taxed resident must be assessed ordinarily (gross income, wealth and other-income thresholds) and the 31 March filing duty.
notes: Fassung vom 29.01.2021. Thresholds are on the page and in QSV Art. 7; read them there.

title: Steueranlagen der Gemeinden von 1983 bis 2026
why_needed: Machine-readable communal and church multipliers per year, plus a sheet with the cantonal Steueranlage for natural and legal persons.
notes: Sheets Daten Gde and Kantonsanlage. Header says Datum 11.06.2026. Linked from sv.fin.be.ch Steueranlagen. The file name has no year; it is extended each year.
